## About
Alta Mere Dallas is The Automotive Outfitters. We tint windows, put on paint protection, and install radar detectors, dash cams, Bluetooth, security and a whole lot more for cars and trucks around the Metroplex.
Whether it's a small hint of color or a complete makeover, we'll help you pick it, install it and show you how to use it. Reviewers know Dan by name, and our management team follows up with you after the work is done.
We're rated 4.5 on Google from 97 reviews. Stop by Lemmon Ave or give us a call.

## Services
- Auto Window Tint: Window tint in different grades and shades to match your car. It helps beat the heat and protects your interior from fading and cracking.
- Auto Paint Protection: An added layer of protection for your paint against dings, scuffs, scratches, sand and dust. You choose the level of coverage you want.
- Radar Detectors: Custom, discreet, long range radar protection, with leading brand equipment and first class installation.
- Dash Cameras: Dash cam installs for your car or truck. One reviewer said every experience was seamless, and that Dan patiently walked them through pulling footage after an accident.
- Bluetooth Connectivity: Get your phone talking to your car.
- Auto Security: Alarms, remote start, keyless entry and GPS tracking to keep your car protected.
